title: Webmaster
summary: Webmaster supporting CCN TV6 and Trinidad Express Newspaper in a fast-moving digital news environment. Managed day-to-day website publishing, digital content, ePaper production, and social media, while also providing video editing support for the 'Beyond the Tape' segment.
achievements: Maintained and published content across the CCN TV6 and Trinidad Express websites
Produced digital ePaper editions and supported the publication workflow
Managed social media content and updates
Edited video content for 'Beyond the Tape'
